discoveries: The measurement scripts of the debug exist only in a session scratchpad. o1 brings a maintained version into the repo, and the harness o4 slice ships the per-review part first.

The dispatch hook blocked two read-only commands during this planning session because their text named a tracker command inside a heredoc or a grep pattern. The debug counted 88 hook blocks on reviewers, 43 of them heredoc false positives. This is not in the plan; it is a candidate for a bug ticket or the next revision.

The first draft of this record measured the static facts in the ops fork at v5.8.0 with local skills, not at this commit; Naqid caught it, and every static fact was re-measured at bace9db. The debug counted 53 skills with an ops-root block in the ops fork, with an unrecorded signature. At this commit, 24 of 67 skills carry the inline walk-up anchored on .apexyard-fork. The o6 grep test uses that anchor as its signature.

The harness o4 slice record is on dev and has no issue yet. An open issue that quotes its slice ID in backticks makes the handoff duplicate check exit 12; the #1619 ticket body was corrected on 2026-10-10 so that /orbit handoff can file it.

Subagent prompt-cache expiries in the baseline: 55 after a pause of at least 5 minutes, re-writing 4.76M tokens (13.0% of 36.5M writes). Subagents default to a 5-minute TTL on every plan. The causes are CI waits and CI-green messages inside reviewers (o4 removes them), 14 review-delta resumes (ac7-6), build-agent resumes and long loops. The plan notes record the TTL facts and the owner trial.
